text: じゃ　あいつらの　かわりに　しょうぶって　ことで　いいな！

structure.jp: あいつらの　かわりに
しょうぶって　ことで
structure.en: with it being that you battle

patterns.name: 〜のかわりに
patterns.span: あいつらの　かわりに
patterns.explanation: の かわりに after a person or thing means 'instead of them, in their place'. あいつらの かわりに = 'in place of those guys'.

patterns.name: 〜ということ
patterns.span: しょうぶって　こと
patterns.explanation: という こと wraps up what comes before as 'the arrangement that ...'; って is the casual form of という. しょうぶって こと = 'the deal being that we battle'.

patterns.name: 〜でいい
patterns.explanation: で いい after something means 'that will do, that is settled'. With な it checks the other person agrees. ことで いいな = 'we'll go with that, right?'.
